differences_from_140: metric_template_item_versions.canonical_metric_id / canonical_semantic_version → LONGTEXT CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL
idx_canonical → non-unique prefix index (canonical_metric_id(128), canonical_semantic_version(16)); query acceleration only

candidate_ddl.unchanged: five table names, PK/FK, unique content hash, JSON columns and their semantics; version and revision stay INT because VersionNumberSchema/RevisionSchema cap at 2147483647

original_140.role: migration source and restore target; not modified

implementation.actor: sqlActorId accepts 0..9007199254740991 or NULL and refuses unsafe integers; fromSqlActorId reads both mysql2 renderings (string and number) with explicit Number.isSafeInteger/range checks; no bitwise/truncating conversion
implementation.timestamps: toSqlTimestamp validates the accepted TimestampSchema and writes the exact 24-character canonical UTC form (years 0000..9999, 0–3 fraction digits normalized to 3); fromSqlTimestamp accepts only that exact form; no DATE_FORMAT and no dependency on the pool timezone/dateStrings
implementation.identity: canonical_metric_id / canonical_semantic_version are copied whole; the accepted ASCII MetricRefSchema is the only textual rule; the prefix index is never used for equality and identity compares the complete key
implementation.preserved: T2A-TX-CLEANUP transaction disposal (release only after a confirmed commit or rollback, destroy otherwise), parent-first lock order, CAS checks, unknown-commit error and redacted identity are unchanged
implementation.known_limits: version/revision pointer columns stay INT; LONGTEXT/packet/driver capacity is a real storage boundary that is rejected explicitly, never claimed unlimited

drill.plan: a fresh process runs `plan` with MAX237_T2B_FORBID_CONNECT=1 and reports connects=false/writes=false; `execute` under the same flag is refused with connection-forbidden
drill.handle: an unknown handle / wrong schema allowlist is refused (handle-mismatch) before any connection
drill.failure_injection: up fails after parent rows and after version snapshot rows; two independent connections read the target empty and the source manifest unchanged
drill.up: one target-connection transaction in parent → draft/items → item versions → template versions order; post-copy manifest equals the source aggregate, source unchanged
drill.adapter_spot_checks: primary key/revision/pointer, NULL actor, year-0000 and year-9999 instants, full JSON snapshot (interval_ms parameter, Unicode/empty/comma dimension keys), source_chain stays the original 1-digit fraction string; re-read after closing and reopening the pool
drill.idempotency: identical re-run reports no-op; a drifted target is refused without overwrite and the candidate row stays drifted until the drill restores it
drill.down_refusal: candidate rows with actor 2147483648, a 512-character canonical id, a 100-character semantic version and a year-0000 timestamp make down fail closed; candidate, source and the empty restore schema are unchanged
drill.down: a safe aggregate copies into the empty DDL 140 restore schema in one transaction; restore manifest equals the source manifest; candidate and source unchanged; identical re-run is a no-op
drill.reproducibility: uses the same cached mysql:8.4 image ID, a new container/volume, and the exact three-schema allowlist; no application migration is registered
